definitions.gloss: change of address notification, moving notice
definitions.explanation: An official form submitted to the local municipal office when moving to a new address. Required by law when changing residence in Japan.

examples.japanese: {転居届|てんきょとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To submit a change of address notification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{転居届|てんきょとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Don't forget to submit a change of address notification after moving.

examples.japanese: {転居届|てんきょとどけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧⟦{十四日|じゅうよっか}→十四日：30216_juuyokka⟧⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{市区町村|しくちょうそん}→市区町村：23061_shikuchouson⟧⟦{役場|やくば}→役場：16694_yakuba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The change of address notification must be submitted to the municipal office within fourteen days before or after moving.

notes:
COMPONENTS: ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧ (change of residence) + {届|とどけ} (notification/report).

When moving within the same municipality, you submit a {転居届|てんきょとどけ}. When moving to a different municipality, the process involves a ⟦{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}→転出届：09810_tenshutsutodoke⟧ (moving-out notice) at the old address and a ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧ (moving-in notice) at the new address.
